cohort: A 12-month-old boy with Crouzon syndrome and multisuture craniosynostosis presenting with increased intracranial pressure and chronic papilledema without ventriculomegaly.
finding: Posterior cranial vault distraction followed by staged fronto-orbital advancement led to complete resolution of papilledema and obviated ventriculoperitoneal shunt placement in a child with Crouzon syndrome.
